review: Reviewed exact source/Core/Smart pair. The Smart runtime is byte-identical to the previous review. The only change in this pair is one Core token: the light branch of --sf-on-disable moves from 24% to 80% of neutral-50, so disabled text in the light theme measures 3.10:1 instead of 1.34:1, level with the 4.12:1 the dark theme already had. smart-base and the loader are unchanged, and no attribute, property, event, slot, nesting rule, cleanup path or asset reference is touched, so none of the eight lessons changes.
